Class 3A playoff preview: Pontiac, Prairie Central and Olympia in Opening Round
Pontiac, Prairie Central and Olympia play in Class 3A Opening Round games this weekend, and according to our projections, two games will be competitive and one will be a blowout.
Pontiac, Prairie Central and Olympia play in Class 3A Opening Round games this weekend, and according to our projections, two games will be competitive and one will be a blowout.
The top eight seeds in each of the North and South brackets of the 48-team Class 3A field have byes in the Opening Round, and the other 32 teams play Friday and Saturday, Oct. 23-24.
Winners advance to the First Round on Saturday, Oct. 31.
We call a game competitive if our projection has it decided by 10 points or fewer and a blowout if the margin is 21 points or more.
Bloomington Central Catholic, the No. 7 seed in the South bracket, has a bye and plays the winner of No. 10 Tolono Unity and No. 23 Robinson in the First Round.
Opening Round schedule and predictions
Friday, Oct. 23
- 7 p.m.: South: No. 24 Columbia (2-7) at No. 9 Olympia (7-2) (Olympia 39, Columbia 15)
- 7:15 p.m.: North: No. 18 Prairie Central (4-5) at No. 15 Chicago Christian (5-4) (Chicago Christian 30, Prairie Central 24)
Saturday, Oct. 24
- noon: North: No. 23 Pontiac (3-6) vs. No. 10 Dyett (6-3) at Lane Stadium (Pontiac 27, Dyett 26)

No. 18 Prairie Central (4-5) at No. 15 Chicago Christian (5-4)
Prairie Central travels to Chicago Christian in the Class 3A Opening Round, and the winner plays at No. 2 Byron (9-0) in the First Round.
Kickoff is 7:15 p.m. Friday.
#18 Prairie Central (4-5)
Prairie Central (4-5) is the No. 18 seed in the 48-team Class 3A field and visits No. 15 Chicago Christian in the Opening Round. It qualified with a losing record.
Prairie Central went 4-5 overall and 4-4 in Illini Prairie, scoring 251 points and allowing 247, an average margin of +0.4 a game.
Prairie Central went 4-5 and missed the playoffs last season. Prairie Central has reached the playoffs in seven of the last 10 seasons.

No. 23 Pontiac (3-6) vs. No. 10 Dyett (6-3)
Pontiac and Dyett meet at Lane Stadium in the Class 3A Opening Round, and the winner plays No. 7 UCCS/Woodlawn (7-2) in the First Round.
Kickoff is noon Saturday.
The projected winner, Pontiac, would face Chicago Public Schools team UCCS/Woodlawn in the First Round, and with CPS teams 9-105 against non-CPS opponents in the playoffs over the five seasons through 2025, a win here is essentially a berth in the Second Round.
